basis: scope delta latest; current batch12/17 coverage, pages inventories, library page prose, plan-spec and cited primary sources

rows.name: General Hodge-theoretic positivity beyond categorification
rows.evidence: Elias–Williamson 1309.0865 introduction discusses Hodge positivity; current A page proves type-A Hecke categorification only. Its 32-item inventory has no Hodge positivity claim.

rows.name: §5 and Definition 5.1: composition of constraint gadgets
rows.evidence: Dinur §5 Definition 5.1 is a valid graph-constraint composition using constant-distance coding. The deferred local assignment-tester draft instead used a unit-vector code and invalid one-bit raw-input block interface; current A inventory omits this composition claim.

rows.name: General positive-characteristic conjectural or counterexample material
rows.evidence: 1702.00039 treats broader characteristic-dependent Soergel behavior; current A frontmatter and exposition fix the reflection realization over Q.

rows.name: Diagrammatic higher-rank relations
rows.evidence: Elias–Williamson §§5.1–5.6 higher-rank diagrammatic relations are addressed by current A-page diagrammatic definition and relation-verification items; B page has only four small examples.

rows.name: §9 and Theorem 9.1: proximity gap amplification
rows.evidence: Dinur §9 Theorem 9.1 needs constant-loss input-preserving robust composition. Local factor ε′/(q s_t) and explicit walk-list size do not prove claimed doubling or polynomial-in-variable-t cost; theorem item removed from 31-item A inventory.

rows.name: §9, Corollary 9.3 proof: the iteration multiplies output size by a constant and runs in polynomial time — worked constants
rows.evidence: Dinur §9 Corollary 9.3 worked output constants require the missing fixed-t doubling map; B page now has three examples and explicitly defers the iteration example.

rows.name: General Coxeter-group classification beyond the finite type-A specialization
rows.evidence: Soergel math/0403496 §6 treats general Coxeter systems; current A page fixes finite S_n over Q.

rows.name: Applications to projectives in category O
rows.evidence: 0707.3603 §6 links Soergel theory to category O projectives; current A page proves categorical Hecke comparison and has no category O result.

rows.name: §9 and Lemma 9.2: two-case soundness with input comparisons
rows.evidence: Dinur §9 Lemma 9.2 itself gives a valid two-case tester soundness statement, including input comparisons. Current local realization cannot feed it through the needed constant-loss composition; current A inventory has no standalone Lemma 9.2 item. Row reason should be read as failure of the local subsequent amplification proof, not as refutation of Dinur’s lemma.

rows.name: General light-leaves computations beyond rank two
rows.evidence: 1702.00039 §5 supplies general light-leaves constructions; the B inventory is four rank-one/rank-two/quadratic examples. Full type-A light/double-leaves claims live in A, so general beyond-rank-two computations are outside B.

rows.name: §9 and Corollary 9.3: polynomial-output assignment tester
rows.evidence: Dinur §9 Corollary 9.3 polynomial-output tester uses a fixed-t constant-ratio amplifier; no verified local supplier remains in current A inventory.

rows.name: §5 and Lemma 1.8: composition proof
rows.evidence: Dinur §5 Lemma 1.8 graph-constraint composition is valid with a constant-distance code. The deferred local assignment-tester composition proof had the unit-vector and raw-input-block defects; no corresponding verified claim remains in A inventory.

rows.name: §9, Corollary 9.3 proof: iterating the transformation $O(\log n)$ times gives a constant rejection probability at polynomial output size
rows.evidence: Dinur §9 Corollary 9.3 O(log n) iteration follows only after fixed-t constant-ratio amplification; that supplier is deferred. Current A inventory omits the iteration.

rows.name: §1.3 and Lemma 1.8: tester composition
rows.evidence: Dinur §1.3/Lemma 1.8 composition setup is source-valid, but the attempted local input-preserving assignment-tester implementation fails constant-distance/raw-bit checks. Current A inventory omits it.

rows.name: Link-cobordism and foam applications
rows.evidence: 0902.4700 develops link-cobordism applications; current A page stops at diagrammatic/bimodule equivalence and Hecke categorification.

rows.name: Link-homology construction and Hochschild homology
rows.evidence: math/0510265 §§3–4 develops Hochschild/triply graded link homology; current B page has only four bimodule/Hecke examples. Planned page hochschild-homology-and-triply-graded-link-homology exists in plan-spec.json.
